rows.en: ＊Kairi＊＠０６５＿００７Good morning... There's￥something I'd like to ask.＝＠０６５＿００８How do you approach your￥training?
＊Kairi＊＠０６５＿００９There must be some reason you￥so easily surpassed an expert￥like me.
＊Kairi＊＠０６５＿０１０I see.￥You must have great focus.＝＠０６５＿０１１And it's not as if I've been￥skipping training either...
＊Kairi＊＠０６５＿０１２In the same amount of time,￥you achieve enough to surpass￥an expert.
＊Kairi＊＠０６５＿０１４Though it's true I don't devote￥myself to just one discipline.＝＠０６５＿０１５I didn't slack off, but perhaps￥I neglected building up my￥knowledge somewhat...
＊Kairi＊＠０６５＿０１６Being well-rounded and able￥to handle anything,￥like you...＝＠０６５＿０１７must be very important for￥getting good scores.
＊Kairi＊＠０６５＿０１８In my specialty, the training￥sticks without fail, but...＝＠０６５＿０１９the moment it's something I'm￥weak at, results come slowly.
＊Kairi＊＠０６５＿０２０Perhaps so. But that doesn't￥mean I can just leave it￥at that.
＊Kairi＊＠０６５＿０２３Thanks to you surpassing me,￥I think I can focus on training￥more than ever before.＝＠０６５＿０２４Sorry to bother you on your￥day off...
